statement: Swati's ruling planet (Vimshottari dasha lord) is Rahu; its presiding deity is Vayu (the wind god), symbolized by a shoot of new growth blown by the wind. It is traditionally associated with independence and self-directed movement, adapting quickly rather than holding a fixed course.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
